scope: Separate-agent mathematical/source/artifact review, plus author visual inspection; not a runtime test or scientific evaluation.

final_rendering_adjustment.change: Prefix two rounded decimal annotations with approximation symbols. Exact data unchanged; prior rendered source/receipt retained in second-generation/.
final_rendering_adjustment.independent_final_source_and_png_review: No blocker: sole source change adds approximation symbols, final PNG is clear, and exact data hashes match the before/after record. Prior122-row arithmetic review carries forward; no arithmetic or tests rerun.

limits: No test suite or production planner executed by the independent reviewer.
Generation calls the existing planner and does not establish its mathematical refinement or a scientific guarantee.
The two score laws are specified hypothetical inputs, not fitted or empirical distributions.
Visual review is bounded; the right panel uses a labeled narrower y-axis.
